resources.string: Every room went away and none came back.
Add a connection first: paste or scan the link you were given on the Connections tab.
That is not a link the app knows. It takes olcrtc:// connection links, olcrtc-sub:// invite links, vless:// REALITY links and https:// list links, or the text of a list.
The room answered, but no traffic goes through it.
The list has no usable connections.
The invite link has no key.
The key does not fit this invite.
The invite was revoked on the server.
The server did not serve an invite list.
It confirms itself once you connect to any room of this server.
The server\'s state is not known yet. Try again in a moment.
Adds one more protocol to this server. Its room can be made here or pasted from the service.
DataChannel is the fastest, where the service supports it. VP8 is data dressed as a video stream. SEI is a slower fallback.
Every device will need the new key. Devices with an invite receive it by themselves; the rest must get a new link.

Sign in once: the app keeps the session to make Telemost rooms. The password stays with Yandex. The saved session gives the app access to the account; it is used only to create rooms, and Settings → Accounts signs out.
Yandex rejected the saved session. Sign in again.

Sign in once: the app keeps the session to make VK calls. The password stays with VK. The saved session gives the app access to the account; it is used only to create calls, and Settings → Accounts signs out.
Sign in to VK on this page
VK did not accept this sign-in. Tap Sign out of VK and sign in again.
VK rejected the saved session. Sign in again.

Sign in once: the app keeps the session to make MTS Link meetings. The password stays with MTS Link. The saved session gives the app access to the account; it is used only to create rooms, and Settings → Accounts signs out.

Sign in if the site asks (an account that already exists and whose e-mail is confirmed; registration is finished through the e-mail the site sends, not here). Then open Meetings → Schedule → Permanent meeting and create it. Do not use Quick meeting: it is a one-off and ends, while the server needs a meeting that stays. Press Finish at the bottom: the app remembers how, and next time one button is enough.
A meeting was created — press Finish.
The app knows how rooms are made.
Room: %1$s — use it? Nothing is learned this time.
No meeting was found on the pages you visited. Create one on the site, or paste its link.
Several meetings were found. Pick yours; nothing is learned this time.
This is a quick meeting: it works only while you are in it. A permanent one is needed: Schedule → Permanent meeting.
This meeting has no session: the server cannot enter it.
MTS Link does not know this meeting.
Could not check the meeting. Try again.
The sign-in stays on this phone and is used only to create rooms.
Create a permanent meeting: Schedule → Permanent meeting, then press Finish.
That is not an MTS Link meeting link.
MTS Link rejected the saved session. Sign in again.
The server rebuilds its core from the version this app speaks and restarts every room. It takes a few minutes; the rooms are away meanwhile.
not the version this app speaks
The tunnel: its state, the chosen connection and one button.
A Telemost room is about to expire
About %1$d h left. Sign in to Yandex on the server page so the app makes a new room by itself.
%1$s got a new room before the old one expired; the connections follow.
One link per device: it gives that device this server\'s connections and keeps them current. Revoking stops the updates and takes server access back.
With access, the device registers its own key with the server agent through this list.
Scan or paste on the other device. The list is encrypted; the key exists only in this link.
Whoever has this link can use the server. Send it only to your own devices or to people you trust.
The list is not on the server yet, or the key is gone.
The device stops getting updates and loses server access. The connections it already has work until the key is rotated.
A SOCKS5 proxy on this phone; only apps set to use it go through the tunnel.
The whole device goes through the tunnel. Only TCP and DNS are carried: calls and some games (UDP) will not work. For those apps use proxy mode, or put them on the direct list.
For rooms carried as video (VP8: data dressed as a video stream). A link with its own tuning keeps it.
For MTS Link the app uses at least 60 frames per second and 64 packets per frame.
Apps must give this login to use the proxy. Proxy mode only.
Telegram gets this phone\'s proxy in one tap while a session runs in proxy mode.
Every site and app goes through the tunnel.
Sites on the list go direct
Sites on the list open straight from your phone, the rest through the tunnel: banks, government services and other Russian sites work as usual.
The country\'s own zones and Russian services on other zones: %1$d rules.
One per line: a site, a link, an address or a network. A site stands for everything under it.
Line %1$d is neither a site nor an address.
Routing applies to the next session.
The link is on the clipboard.
Round trip, download speed and the exit address, room by room and all together.
Connect first: the check measures the live session as it is.
Each download runs for up to eight seconds through the room\'s own port, then through the port apps use, where every room carries it at once.
%1$d lines. Blanked before they are kept: keys, ids, server addresses, room ids, the secret parts of links.
The log is on the clipboard.
The VPN permission was not granted.
The room is empty or has expired: refresh the list, or ask the person who gave you the link for a new one.
Another app holds the proxy port: change the port in Settings, or close that app.
The address could not be looked up: there is no internet, or the address in the link is wrong.
The server answered with HTTP %1$d: the list is not there, or the link is wrong.
The service answered with HTTP %1$d. Try again in a minute.
The service answered in a form the app cannot read. Try again in a minute.
The Xray core could not start: %1$s. Check the link, or ask for a new one.
No answer from the server: check the internet, or try again in a minute.
The server does not answer: check the internet, or try again in a minute.
The server did not accept this phone: check the phone\'s date and time, or ask the owner for a new invite.
The server\'s certificate is not the one the invite named: ask the owner for a new invite.
Point the camera at the QR code of a link.
The camera is needed to read a QR code. Allow it, or paste the link instead.
Only VLESS + REALITY links are supported (this one uses %1$s).
Tap a connection to choose it. The ⋯ button or a long press: check, copy the link, show QR, remove.
Remove \"%1$s\"? The link is not kept.

resources.string: A connection comes as a link. The person who runs the server sends it to you: in a message, as a QR code, or as a list.
The app takes a connection link (olcrtc://), a subscription or invite link (olcrtc-sub://, https://), a VLESS REALITY link (vless://), or the text of a whole list.
A connection goes through a video-call room on the server, so its traffic looks like a call. That is what \"room\" means in the app.
Or type or edit the link here:
Only TCP and DNS are carried in VPN mode: calls and some games will not work. Use proxy mode for them, or put them on the direct list.
The port must be between 1024 and 65535; the old value is kept.
An address with a port, for example 1.1.1.1:53.
Only an address with an optional port, like 1.1.1.1:53; the old value is kept.
Works in apps with their own SOCKS5 proxy setting: Telegram, Firefox, torrent clients, many browsers. Apps without one need VPN mode.
The sign-ins kept for making rooms. A saved session gives the app access to the account; it is used only to create rooms.
Signed in: the app can make Telemost rooms.
Not signed in. The server page asks when a Telemost room is needed.
Signed in: the app can make VK calls.
Not signed in. The server page asks when a VK call is needed.
The app has not learned yet: create a permanent meeting in the sign-in window once.
The app has not learned how to make a room yet. Create a permanent meeting here once and press Finish.
No saved MTS Link sign-in. Sign in here, then create the meeting.
The page gave the app no token for the request. Create the meeting here; the log has the details.
The automatic attempt failed. Create the meeting here; the log has the details.
The server leaves the list on this phone. This phone stays registered on the server until its owner revokes it.
Revoke access for \"%1$s\"? The device loses server access and stops getting updates.
Have a VPS of your own? The app installs the server on it; after that you send links to the family from here.

The app signs in to your VPS over SSH and installs everything: podman, the server in a video-call room and the agent this phone manages it through. A fresh VPS with Debian, Ubuntu or Fedora and root access is enough. It takes 5–15 minutes.
Private key (paste the text of the file)
Optional: a room name or a full link; empty makes a random room. Public Jitsi servers, no account. DataChannel is recommended; the video transports work too.
A Telemost room link or id. Tap \"Make a room\" to create one with your Yandex account, or paste one made at telemost.yandex.ru.
A VK call link (vk.com/call/join/…). Tap \"Make a room\" and the app makes one with your VK sign-in, or paste a link from the VK app. Carried as video (VP8): about 13–19 Mbit/s.
A SaluteJazz meeting as code:password, or its link. No account needed: tap \"Make a room\" and the app makes the room itself. Carried as data (DataChannel).

A permanent MTS Link meeting (my.mts-link.ru/j/…). Once you have created one meeting in the sign-in window, the app learns how and one button makes rooms; or paste a link. Video only (VP8, sent as VP9): about 15 Mbit/s. The free plan allows two permanent meetings. The phone connects over TCP by default; add ?ice=udp to the end of the link for UDP.
Fill in the address, the user and the password or the key.
This service needs a room: make one or paste it.
Keep the app open: the install takes 5–15 minutes. The screen stays on by itself.
The server is installed and this phone manages it.
If the hoster has a firewall panel, open TCP port %1$d there.
Starting the install on the server…
Sign in as root: the install needs it.
The server printed no connection link.
The install did not finish in 25 minutes. Check the server and try again.
The server\'s SSH key is not the one this phone remembers. If the server was reinstalled, that is expected; otherwise someone may be in the way. Forget the server on its page and try again.
The server did not accept the login: check the user and the password or the key.
The agent could not be installed: %1$s
This build carries no installer: the server script is missing from the app.
This phone has no SSH login for the server.
The agent is rebuilt on the server from the sources this app carries and restarted; the rooms are not touched. Do this after a core update, or when the server page shows no readings.
Every protocol of this server at once: the speeds add up, and when one room drops out the others carry on.
No bonding endpoint on the server: the rooms take turns
The olcos-bond container is stopped on the server and the connection is deleted from this phone. The connections of the separate protocols stay.
The key of the server is unknown on this phone: none of its connections is saved.
What you added yourself: links, QR codes and files.
Your subscriptions, ready-made lists and Xray servers
No connections from this server yet. Open the server to install one.
olcOS installs everything it needs on your server by itself.
No connections yet. Tap + to add a link, a QR code or a subscription.
Check the connection while it runs
Every half minute a request goes through the tunnel. If three in a row get no answer, or the phone changes networks, the app connects again.
If the connection stops working, the app moves to another one that works. A whole-server connection already keeps going when one of its rooms drops; this switch is for when the whole server stops.
Connects the chosen connection when you open the app.
Reconnecting failed. Tap Retry to try again.
Opens the system\'s language choice for this app.
When the app opens, it checks which connections work.
Hides IP addresses on screen — for screenshots. Copying and logs stay real.
Auto-update per protocol: a room is made fresh once it is old enough.
Night is 02:00–06:00 by the phone\'s clock.
The change happens within that hour, by the phone\'s clock.
A room lives 24 hours; the app renews it ahead of time.
Rooms do not expire. Change them on a schedule if you like.
Until the app has learned how to make MTS Link meetings, its rooms stay as they are.
The free MTS Link plan allows 2 permanent meetings, so delete old ones in your account.
Nothing here yet. Connections of servers you manage appear once their protocol is switched on above.
Applies to connections whose server you manage. A skipped connection keeps its room until you change it by hand.
%1$s: the %2$s room was made fresh; the connections follow.
The saved %1$s sign-in no longer works, so the room was left as it is. Sign in again in Settings → Accounts.
The room could not be changed
The saved VK sign-in no longer works. Sign in again in Settings → Accounts.
The saved MTS Link sign-in no longer works. Sign in again in Settings → Accounts.
